interface.longDescription: Operator v6-alpha: an experimental local MCP Apps cockpit with a registered-project sidebar, English and Polish interface, and host-aware light/dark appearance. Requires Node 20+ and initialized Operator workspaces. Use the bundled console CLI to print a machine-local MCP connection. Existing Operator execution workflows remain human-supervised.
